name: vibes-monorepo

scripts.vibes:build: bun build apps/api/src/index.ts --target bun --external @napi-rs/keyring --outfile dist/api.js && bun build apps/tui/src/index.tsx --target bun --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/react --outfile dist/tui.js
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:apps
scripts.test: bun run --filter './packages/*' test && bun run --filter @vibes/tui test

//overrides: Force a single ai version: the OpenRouter/Exa/Zhipu providers still peer-depend on ai@^6, which otherwise installs a second ai@6 copy alongside ai@7 and makes editors resolve `ai` types inconsistently (e.g. a stale 3-arg ToolLoopAgent). They emit v3-spec models that ai@7 accepts, so pinning ai to 7 is safe.
